summary: Verified the OfficeFlow admin dashboard feature update. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (admin/dashboard-stats, admin/employee-status w/ RBAC 403 for employee, admin/employee/{id}/stats monthly+yearly+attendance+gps, admin/employee/{id}/role change, tasks with work_type=work_from_home including assignee_name, task default work_type=in_office, leaves create->list->approve full flow with employee 403). Frontend Playwright checks: admin sees Live Map in sidebar, 4 stat cards, employee-status-panel + Quick Actions (Manage/Assign Task/Approve Leaves/Open Live Map) all render; /dashboard/live-map renders react-leaflet OpenStreetMap tiles with a live marker for the working test employee; Tasks 'Assign Task' dialog exposes title/description/assignee-select/work-type-office/work-type-wfh/priority/submit; Leaves admin sees no pending section (none pending after backend test) but Apply button present; Employee login correctly hides Live Map nav, hides Approve/Reject (no pending-leaves-section), and hides create-task-button.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py get_dashboard_stats does not enforce require_admin (only get_current_user). Any authenticated employee can read total_employees / pending_leaves / active_tasks counts. Consider adding require_admin(request, db) for parity with /employee-status.
admin.py change_employee_role uses ObjectId(employee_id) directly; a malformed id will raise 500 instead of a clean 400. Wrap with try/except InvalidId -> 400.

leaves.py PUT /leaves/{id}: an employee could still update via 403 check but there is no restriction preventing an employee from updating their own leave status through a hypothetical bug; the current 403 guard is correct - just noting the status transition (approved -> rejected -> approved) is not validated.

tasks.py delete_task: only checks authentication, no role guard. Any employee assigned to a task cannot delete via employee filter (task lookup ignores role), but a non-assigned employee can DELETE another user's task if they know the id (existing check does not filter by assigned_to). Consider adding role/assignee check on DELETE.
admin.py employee-status returns full coordinates_today list which may be large; consider trimming or paginating for many concurrent employees.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Live Map depends on gps_sessions with status='active'. The test employee currently has an active session with coords ~ (23.7927, 90.3705) which shows on the map as one marker. If active gps sessions are ended, the map will show no markers (expected). Backend admin routes are mounted under /api/admin. leaves.build_leave_response includes user_name/user_email/approver_name.
